# more
note: 「more+形容词+复数名词」(more diverse voices / more effective measures) 既可读作程度也可读作数量，界线拿不准；more than 只把「超过/不仅仅/more than once」类标成 P，纯比较(complain more than men)按义项标；more or less 标了 P
